description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the path to a folder containing the XML file. If the folder contains a redirections.xml, it will be copied to the local profile and immediately used.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\RedirXMLSourceFolder
Type:  REG_SZ
